## Objective
Find the exact release date of Python 3.12.0 and identify its single most significant new feature/novelty. Return only structured, sourced facts.

## Context
The Owner wants two precise facts about Python 3.12.0 with verifiable citations from live web sources. The official Python docs (docs.python.org, python.org/downloads) and PEP documents are the authoritative sources. Cross-reference at least two independent sources per claim.

## Output contract
Return ONLY this structure, nothing else:

```
### Python 3.12.0 Release Date
[exact date in DD/MM/YYYY format, with inline URL citation]

### Principal Novidade
[most impactful new feature of 3.12, 1-2 sentences, with inline URL citation]

### SOURCES
- [URL1]
- [URL2]
...
```

Every factual claim must carry an inline citation. No preamble, no closing remarks, no prose outside the structure above.

## Boundaries
- Only Python 3.12.0 — not 3.12.1, not 3.11, not any other version.
- "Principal novidade" means the single most impactful/headline feature, not a list.
- Return verbatim output only. Do not add commentary, analysis, or recommendations.
- Real fetched URLs only — no parametric memory as sole source.
